_note: Post-session survey for USER TESTING mode only.

likert.text: The conversation with the troll was engaging.
I had to think hard to figure out how to get past the troll.
I felt I could steer the troll's behaviour with what I said.
The troll stayed in character the whole time.
The troll's hints felt fair: helpful without giving the answer away.

open.text: Did the troll ever give you the answer or a letter of it? What did it say?
Was there a moment the troll did what you pushed for even though it should not have? Describe it.
